newsitem.title: BRAZIL: France's Scor opens office in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: France's Scor opens office in Brazil.

text.p: France's largest reinsurance firm, Scor SA, has opened an office in Rio de Janeiro to enter the promising Brazilian insurance market with new products and services, company officials said.

"Our essential objective in this market is to bring new products and services," said Scor Director General Pierre-Denis Champvillard. "Apart from these new products, we would like to introduce new methods of selling insurance...and also modern methods of handling insurance claims."

Scor's life insurance director, Yves Chiche, said Brazil would not escape the worldwide trend of devolving state social security provisions to the private sector. He said demand for life, pension and health insurance products was expected to grow in Brazil.

"We are interested in the Brazilian market because we think this immense market which is gradually attaining monetary stability is a favorable terrain for the development of private insurers," Chiche said.
Champvillard said the value of the Brazilian insurance market doubled in little time to become the fifth ranking in the world at $15 billion in 1995.
Scor is also seeking a Brazilian presence to study the country's reinsurance market, which is being opened to private capital.
Champvillard estimated that Brazil's reinsurance market currently worth $800 million could "easily" reach $1.5 billion once the state monopoly was broken.

Scor, which reinsures France's space program, is the second foreign reinsurer to open an office in Brazil. In August, Swiss Resinsurance Co opened an office Sao Paulo to conduct market studies and make contacts with possible future clients.

Scor's Rio office will be in charge of the company's life insurance operations in all of South America and the risk insurance business in the countries belonging to the Mercosur customs union. Scor already has offices in Colombia, Venezuela and Mexico.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
